title: fix(app-shell): the connector action Input repeater follows the run's declared-keys rule
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Sj8HDD6VgNcGGzfkHLnCCh)_

Fixes #33838

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/i18n` gains the studio pack key `engine.inspector.flowNode.kv.undeclaredKey` (en, zh); nothing removed or narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio 里连接器动作（connector_action）的 Input「键/值」附加项编辑器，现在按运行时同一条规则判断动作输入是开放还是封闭；封闭时只给声明了但没有专用输入框的键（如 OpenAPI 的 `$ref`/无 schema 的 `body`、Slack 的 `blocks`）留编辑位，其余未声明键逐行标红「运行时会拒绝」。
- **为什么改**：#33614 之后，运行时会拒绝动作未声明的输入键；Studio 却仍按 JSON Schema 默认「开放」处理，照常让作者加这些键，保存后流程一跑就失败。
- **风险与回滚**：只动 Studio 前端与 i18n 文案，不改任何服务端包；旧流程里已存的未声明键不会被自动删除，只是被标出。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`connector-input-fields.ts`（`connectorInputContractKeys` 与 `applyConnectorInputForm` 的保留条件）、`FlowNodeConfigField.tsx`（`acceptedKeyProps`）、`FlowKeyValueField.tsx`（`keyRefusal` 行）。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/connector-input-fields.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.connectorInput.test.tsx`，预期全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/connector-input-fields.ts` decided open/closed with JSON Schema's default (`additionalProperties !== false` = open). No shipped connector writes `additionalProperties`, so Studio read every action as open and kept offering the extras repeater for keys the run now refuses.

**The rule, read from the run (origin/main `385ea1cc`):**

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-input-schema.ts:138` — `KEY_ADMITTING_KEYWORDS` (copied verbatim into the ui module).
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-input-schema.ts:160` — `declaredKeysOf`: declared = `properties` names plus `required` names; open when `additionalProperties` / `unevaluatedProperties` is anything but `false`, when a key-admitting keyword (`$ref`, `allOf`/`anyOf`/`oneOf`, `patternProperties`, …) is present, or when no `properties` is listed and the schema is not `additionalProperties: false`.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-input-schema.ts:275`–`285` — the walk refuses every key `declaredKeysOf` does not list.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/connector-nodes.ts:165` — the `connector_action` door passes `{ refuseUndeclaredKeys: true }`.
- `packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/openapi-connector.ts:569` — an unresolved `$ref` or schemaless request body is declared `body: {}` (any value); `:558` — an unresolved `$ref` parameter opens the `path`/`query`/`header` sections with `additionalProperties: true`.

**Studio now:**

- `connectorInputContractKeys(schema)` mirrors `declaredKeysOf` for the top level of `connectorConfig.input` (`null` = open). `ConnectorInputForm` gains `contractKeys`; `open` is `contractKeys === null`.
- `applyConnectorInputForm` keeps the repeater when the schema is open, when it declares a key no typed field owns (an openapi `body: {}`, slack's item-less `blocks`), or when the stored map holds a key no typed field owns. On a closed schema the repeater carries a new `FlowConfigField.acceptedKeys` (the declared keys).
- `FlowNodeConfigField` turns `acceptedKeys` into two `FlowKeyValueField` props: `keyOptions` (the declared keys no sibling field types, as key-cell suggestions) and the new `keyRefusal`, which draws one `role="alert"` line under any row whose key the schema does not declare.
- `connectorInputFields` now resolves a CLOSED schema even when no property gets a typed field (a body-only openapi operation), so its repeater is judged too; an open schema with no typed field still returns `null` (the generic repeater, unchanged).

**Stored keys the run would now refuse: marked, never dropped.** A stored undeclared key on a closed schema keeps the repeater alive and stays in its row, with the line "The action does not declare this input, so the run refuses it. Remove it, or pick an action that declares it." under it. Rendering writes nothing back (pinned: `onPatch` is not called); the author removes the row. A key typed into the repeater that the action does not declare gets the same line as soon as it is typed.

## Tests

New pins (all ablated red, below):

- `connector-input-fields.test.ts` — new `describe('connectorInputContractKeys — the run's declared-keys rule')` (closed on `properties`; `required` names declared; `additionalProperties: false` with no properties declares none; `additionalProperties`/`unevaluatedProperties` true or a schema is open; each key-admitting keyword is open; no `properties` is open). In `applyConnectorInputForm`: closed with every key typed → no repeater; open (`allOf`) → repeater, no `acceptedKeys`; closed slack → repeater kept for `blocks` with `acceptedKeys`; openapi `$ref`/schemaless `body: {}` → repeater offers `body`; body-only operation still resolves; stored undeclared key on a closed schema → repeater kept and judged.
- `FlowNodeInspector.connectorInput.test.tsx` (the existing harness, new top-level `describe`): a stored undeclared key on a closed schema renders one `flow-kv-key-refusal` alert and writes nothing; an open (`allOf`) schema marks no key; a declared-but-untyped `body` shows in the repeater unmarked.

Forced test edits (the old rule they pinned is the defect):

- `connector-input-fields.test.ts` — `describe('connectorInputFields — measured additionalProperties semantics')` removed: its first case pinned "an ABSENT additionalProperties is OPEN", the rule this card retires; its other two cases are re-pinned in the new `connectorInputContractKeys` block.
- `connector-input-fields.test.ts` — "an OPEN schema keeps the repeater…" now uses an `allOf` schema (slack's verbatim schema is closed under the run's rule); "a CLOSED schema drops the repeater entirely" now uses slack without `blocks`, since a closed schema with an untyped declared key keeps the repeater; the in-place splice case's comment says why the repeater is still there.
- `FlowNodeInspector.connectorInput.test.tsx` — "an undeclared stored key stays editable in the extras repeater (schema is OPEN)" renamed to "(never hidden or dropped)", body unchanged; "a CLOSED schema (additionalProperties:false) drops the repeater" now uses slack without `blocks`, for the same reason.

## Acceptance notes

- **Nested open sections stay as before.** The run judges nested objects too. An openapi `query` section opened by an unresolved `$ref` parameter (`additionalProperties: true` beside declared `properties`) is flattened into typed sub-fields by the resolver, so a key outside them was not editable in the form before this PR and still is not; a section with no declared parameters is a `keyValue` field, unjudged (open, as the run reads it). Stored undeclared keys inside a closed nested section are likewise not shown. Neither is a key Studio offers, so neither is in this card's repeater; recorded here, not filed.
- **Action switch (objectstack#33346) keeps typed keys only.** On a connector or action switch the inspector keeps the held keys the new action's typed fields own (`declaredKeys`), so a declared-but-untyped key such as `body` is dropped on the switch. Unchanged by this PR; it could keep `contractKeys` instead. Recorded, not filed.
- The marked key does not hold Studio's autosave or appear in the flow problems list; the line is inline only. The run's own refusal is unchanged.

## Verification

<details><summary>Targeted suites (merged head)</summary>

Head `3b90535e`, under `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0 each):

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` — exit 0.
- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `connector-input-fields.test.ts`, `FlowNodeInspector.connectorInput.test.tsx`, `FlowNodeInspector.connectorActionSwitch-33346.test.tsx`, `FlowNodeInspector.connectorInputEnvelope-28164.test.tsx`, `FlowNodeInspector.connectorOutputRefs-11028.test.tsx`, the three `FlowKeyValueField.*.test.*` files, `FlowNodeConfigField.test.tsx`, `FlowNodeConfigField.entryCondition.test.tsx` and `packages/i18n/` — `Test Files 112 passed (112)`, `Tests 2025 passed | 13 skipped (2038)`.
- Narrowed on purpose: the full app-shell suite is left to CI `Test UI`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored; `git diff HEAD` empty after)</summary>

Each leg through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob moved), running `connector-input-fields.test.ts` + `FlowNodeInspector.connectorInput.test.tsx`; ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to `src/`, so no build sits between mutation and run.

1. `connectorInputContractKeys`: `if (!properties && additional !== false) return null;` → `if (additional !== false) return null;` (the retired JSON-Schema default) — **9 failed | 42 passed**, including every closed-schema pin in both files.
2. `FlowNodeConfigField`: the `acceptedKeyProps(...)` spread forced off — **1 failed | 50 passed**: "a stored key a CLOSED schema does not declare is shown and marked as refused by the run".
3. `applyConnectorInputForm`: `untyped.length > 0` dropped from `keepRepeater` — **4 failed | 47 passed** (slack `blocks`, openapi `body: {}`, body-only operation, in-place splice). The render pin for `body` stays green here because the stored `body` keeps the repeater on its own; the unit pins carry this leg.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, merged head)</summary>

Head `3b90535e`; `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 37 commands; all 37 ran, each `:: exit 0`. `--ran` reconciliation: `37 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.

The first round (head `d9362095`) had `pnpm check:test-source-alias` red: the edited harness reaches a lazy `import('@objectstack/lint')`. Fixed in `3b90535e` by the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint';` the gate prescribes (precedent: `FlowNodeInspector.connectorActionSwitch-33346.test.tsx`). Every other command was green in both rounds.

</details>
